column1: # Hand-verified net.minecraft -> com.mojang.blaze3d class migrations that
# compose_mojang.py cannot derive on its own.
# WHY compose_mojang misses these: it composes the 1.21.11 proguard log with
# 1.21.11 intermediary. A class that Mojang moved OUT of net.minecraft INTO
# com.mojang.blaze3d at or before 1.21.11 is, at 1.21.11, no longer an
# intermediary (net.minecraft) class -- so there is no class_NNN -> blaze3d row
# to compose. But a 1.20.1-era corpus mod still carries the OLD intermediary
# token (class_NNN) in its bytecode, and the converter has no rule to send it
# to the blaze3d name that 26.2 actually ships. Result: the ref keeps the old
# token, which exists nowhere on 26.2 -> link-check CLAIMED / BLIND, and SAM /
# facade descriptors that mention the type silently fail to match.
# Each row verified against data/jars/client-1.20.1-intermediary.jar (the token
# IS this type at 1.20.1, by member shape) AND data/jars/client-26.2.jar (the
# target name exists there). Appended to data/mappings/inter-to-mojang-1.21.11.tsv
# by pkgmoves.py's recipe step 6 (cat this onto the deployed table).
# TODO root-fix: teach pkgmoves.py to match across the net.minecraft ->
# com.mojang.blaze3d boundary (its simple-name + member-shape matcher currently
# only ranges over net.minecraft candidates), so this hand list is not needed.
# where it is already opengl, so the platform-named key a 1.20.1 mod carries
# has no row. Outer class + nested state classes (BlendState/BooleanState/...).
# class_1289: 映射表拼写错 InstantenousMobEffect(缺a) -> 26.2 真名 InstantaneousMobEffect
